page.title: Sensitive access
page.intro: Every time a recording, transcript, customer detail, document or export is read, we keep a record of who, when and what kind of data. We never store the content itself.
page.ownerOnly: Only the account owner can open this page.

rules.bulk_scraping: Large number of records read in a few minutes
rules.former_employee_access: Access by someone who is no longer on your team

bulk_scraping: Open the access history of a recently viewed record and check who read it.
Ask that person whether the activity was expected.
If not, remove their access under Team and rotate any API key they could use.
off_hours_spike: Check whether the person was working late on purpose.
If unexpected, ask them to sign in again and review their recent activity.
former_employee_access: Remove the person from Team immediately if they should not have access.
Revoke their active sessions and any API keys they created.
Review the access history of the records they opened.
export_volume: Open Exports and check who created the large export.
Confirm the export was needed. Expire it if not.
Review who has the export permission.
